ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Mayhem.cs:11-14) == cost 2 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars, and no animation trigger in the C# body.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<MayhemPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Mayhem.cs:18) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, MayhemPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Literal 1 on both sides. MayhemPower's start-of-turn top-of-draw-pile auto-play belongs to the power stream -- and note that if it routes through the same inline reimplementation card/havoc uses rather than `CombatState.auto_play_card`, it inherits havoc's finding; that is the power stream's to check.
